name: Scaleway Instances

evidence.vps: 03: public-cloud virtual machines; Scaleway manages the hardware and the customer manages the guest OS and app

line: Launch virtual machines in Scaleway availability zones.

free.text: No recurring free CPU Instance allowance

cells.regions: Paris, Amsterdam, Warsaw, Milan; family availability differs
cells.selfhost: Yes; root access, manage the guest OS

work.math: €0.438 for compute + €0.949 for volume + €3.65 for an IPv4 address = €5.037 a month before tax. 100 GB of data sent out is included, and builds run on the VM. Scaleway DNS adds €5.11.
€6.5554 for compute + €0.949 for volume + €3.65 for an IPv4 address + €5.11 for Scaleway DNS = €16.2644 a month before tax. 100 GB of data sent out is included, but throughput is untested.

€14.746 compute + €1.898 volume + €3.65 IPv4 + €0.5621 for 70 GB of backups = €20.8561 before tax. Assumes seven full 10 GB dumps; actual size unknown. Same-VM database traffic adds no cost. Scaleway DNS adds €5.11.
